rationale: For a fast-paced restaurant POS where staff log multiple expenses daily, clarity and speed are paramount. The Swiss archetype provides a highly functional, low-decoration environment that reduces cognitive load. High contrast ensures readability on POS tablets, while pure functional colors (Red for expense, Green for income) guide actions.

components.kpi_card: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Square or slight radius (max 8px). High contrast. Primary: Black background, White text. Secondary: White background, 1px border, Black text.
components.inputs: Shadcn input style. Focus state: ring-2 ring-primary offset-2.
components.table: Dense padding (py-2 px-3). Subtle alternating row colors (bg-white / bg-gray-50) for readability. Sticky header.
components.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar. Active state highlighted with primary background and white text or subtle gray background with black text and left border indicator.
components.bulk_editor: Spreadsheet-style grid. Minimal padding, visible cell borders, zero gap between cells. Click-to-edit behavior.

expenses.layout: Vertical stack: KPI Strip -> Date Picker & Quick Add Form -> Data Table.
features: KPI Strip: 5 summary cards (Today's Total, Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, Cash Draw).
Quick Add Form: Inline layout. Category dropdown -> Item Search dropdown -> Amount -> Payment Method.
Expandable 'More Fields': Use an accordion or toggle for Qty + Unit.
Data Table: Time, Item, Category, Amount, Payment Method, Actions. Click row for inline edit.

expense_setup.layout: Two-column Master-Detail. Categories on left, Items on right.
features: Left Panel: List of categories with count badges. Add/Edit/Delete.
Right Panel: Toolbar (Search, Bulk Edit toggle, Excel Import/Export) -> Data Table.
Standard Mode Table: Name, Unit Price (click to edit), Unit, Actions.
Bulk Editor Mode: Spreadsheet grid. Editable dropdowns for Category/Unit, input for Price.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React 19, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' via Google Fonts.
Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing (e.g., data-testid='expense-submit-button').
Ensure responsive layout: mobile-first stacking, then multi-column for md/lg (tablets).
Build the Bulk Editor as a dense, grid-based table similar to a spreadsheet for fast data entry.
Include hover states for all clickable elements with proper contrast.
